_readme: Structured closing times. Notion's `Hours` is free prose filled for only 46/366 places, so it cannot
be planned against directly — this file is the machine-readable version, filled in as each day is
reviewed. rebuild.mjs CAPS a stop's dwell at `closes` and flags it if the chain arrives after
`lastEntry`. A place absent from this file is simply not capped.
conf: high = confirmed against the operator; med = consistent secondary sources; low = assumed.

National Museum.source: Researched note in rebuild/beijing.json. CONFLICT: Notion's Hours prose for this place says 'To 17:30 in summer, last entry 16:30'. Planning against the EARLIER pair, because being wrong the other way loses the visit; if 17:30 turns out to be right you simply gain 30 min.

Forbidden City.source: Palace Museum summer hours 08:30-17:00, last entry 16:00. Entry is by timed slot; the morning slot admits 08:30-12:00.

Jingshan Park.source: ASSUMED summer 06:30-21:00. Notion has no Hours value for this place and it was not in the researched set — confirm before relying on a late slot.

798 Art District.source: Notion Hours field: 'Galleries ~10:00-18:00'. The district streets stay walkable later but the galleries — the reason to be there — shut at 18:00.

UCCA.source: Notion has no Hours value for UCCA. 19:00 comes from the researched note in rebuild/beijing.json ('UCCA stays open to 19:00 when the smaller galleries have already shut'), which is why it is scheduled last. 14 Aug 2026 is a Friday, so the Monday closure does not bite.

Summer Palace.source: Notion Hours: 'Gates 06:00, sights 08:00'. Grounds open early and close late; the ticketed buildings are the binding constraint. Not currently binding — the visit ends before noon.

Wuhou Shrine.source: Verified in the Chengdu notes: 09:00-18:00, ticket sales stop 17:00. Called out there as 'the single fragile point in the whole plan' — if the run back from Guanghan slips, this is the casualty. The Western Garden zone stays open 07:00-22:00 if you arrive too late for the main halls.

Sanxingdui Museum.source: Notion Hours: 'Jul-Aug 08:30-20:00 (last entry 18:00); closed Mondays'. 21 Aug 2026 is a Friday. The late summer hours are insurance against a morning slip, not licence to start late — a late start kills Wuhou and Jinli.

Daci Temple.source: Halls close 17:30, ticket check ends 17:00 (the Zen tea area runs to 19:30, the halls do not); needs ID/QR registration at the gate. It was mis-tagged Evening in the source data, which is why it ended up parked — there is no daylight hour left for it.

Chengdu Panda Base.source: Notion Hours: 'Opens 07:30; pandas most active 07:30-09:30'. Closing not stated in the source; 18:00 is the standard summer close. Not binding — the visit is deliberately front-loaded and ends before noon.

Hongya Cave.source: Notes: light-up ~20:00 in summer (NOT the 19:00 the original data assumed), running to ~23:00; shops trade 10:00-23:00. The 19:30-22:00 window is peak crush and after 21:00 is materially calmer, which is why day 1 puts it late — but the 105-min advice then runs past the lights going out.

Raffles Crystal deck.source: Notion Hours: '10:00-21:00', booking required. Not binding — the 15:00 slot is heat management as much as sightseeing.

Golden Whip Stream.source: ASSUMED, and the least certain entry in this file. The binding constraint is not a gate but the last eco-shuttle out of the valley — the trail is a 7.5 km unlit gorge and Wulingyuan's inner shuttles wind down around 18:00-19:00. Confirm the last shuttle from Shuiraosimen when you buy the park ticket. The day-1 note already anticipates this: walk part-way and turn back rather than committing to the full length.

Temple of Heaven.source: Park gates 06:00-21:00 but the ticketed halls run 08:00-17:00 — the halls are the binding constraint.

Tuojiang night boat.source: Notion Hours: night sailings ~18:00-23:00. The city note narrows it: do not board before ~20:00 (it must be genuinely dark and the illumination comes up 19:30-20:00), and sailings stop about 23:00. Ride is ~30 min round trip from the North Gate wharf past the lit Wanming Tower. Booking required.

Two Rivers & Four Lakes.source: City note: runs 19:00-21:30 normally, EXTENDED to 18:00-23:00 June-October, departures every 10-30 min, ~1.5 h for the full two-rivers loop. 29 Aug falls inside the extended season. The lights and the lit pagodas are the entire point, so the real constraint is the earliest useful departure (~19:45, after the ~19:05 sunset), not the last one.

Shanghai Museum East.source: Wed-Mon 10:00-18:00, last entry 17:00, closed TUESDAY. 7 Sep 2026 is a Monday, so it is open — but it does not open until 10:00, and the chain had it starting at 08:00.

Yu Garden.source: Closed Mondays; 5 Sep 2026 is a Saturday. Until 31 Oct 2026 it runs 09:00-21:50 on Saturdays, so the 16:30 in the source data no longer applies — but it still does not OPEN before 09:00.

City God Temple.source: 08:30-16:30, no entry after 16:00 — keep it in the morning block with Yu Garden.

West Bund Museum.source: Closes 17:00, last admission 16:00, CLOSED MONDAYS. Day 5 (Sunday 6 Sep) is the only workable slot in the trip.

Long Museum West Bund.source: 10:00-21:00 Fri-Sun, closed Mondays. The latest-closing West Bund venue, so it is the safe last stop of that mile.

TANK Shanghai.source: 10:00-18:00 at weekends, admission ends 17:30. Does not open at 08:00, which is where the chain had it.

Jing’an Temple.source: Notion Hours: ~07:30-17:00. Day 2 must reach it by ~15:45.

M50 Creative Park.source: Galleries 10:00-18:00 and most are closed Mondays; day 2 is a Thursday. Opens at 10:00, not 09:44.
